title: Teletubby
tagline: Basic wallet integration for Kinto chain using the wallet SDK
description: Setting up and integrating the Kinto Wallet SDK to a basic DAPP that helps you connect to wallet, play a game and accrue some points based on the number of puzzles solved. The Kinto Wallet SDK provides a seamless way to interact with Kinto's Ethereum Layer 2 solution, enabling fast and secure transactions
how_its_made:
The project uses the wallet SDK and blockscout API for helping on the UX side on what s happening. The main component used is the wallet SDK. Tried integrating the venn network for verification in Smart contracts, it d WIP.
